records.text: 14 Alder Court listed at $749,000: 3 bed, 2 bath, 1,850 sq ft, built 1962, in Maple Hollow.

records.label: 1998 roof
records.text: Seller disclosure for 14 Alder Court: the roof is the original 1998 roof; a 2025 leak left a water stain on the hall ceiling (leak repaired).

records.label: dues only
records.text: Maple Hollow HOA for 14 Alder Court: dues are $310 a month, no special assessments pending.

records.label: new roof
records.text: Roof replacement at 14 Alder Court is finished: new architectural shingles, 30-year warranty, city permit closed.
Price change on 14 Alder Court: now $699,000.

records.label: $14,500 assessment
records.text: Maple Hollow HOA voted a $14,500 special assessment per home for the pool and clubhouse rebuild, payable in 2027. Sellers must disclose it.
Showing feedback from Dev Patel (Westgate Homes): nice house, but the buyers think it is priced well above the recent sales nearby.

Showing feedback from Marcus Bell (Bell & Co.): the asking price is the sticking point for them.

Showing feedback from Priya Nair (Harbor Lane Realty): asked twice who pays the special assessment; liked the new roof; the kitchen is dated.
Showing feedback from Marcus Bell (Bell & Co.): the kitchen is dated; otherwise it shows well.
Seller (the Hollis family) is relocating to Denver and wants to close before 2026-12-15; flexible on the move-out date.
Lockbox code for 14 Alder Court changes every Monday; ask the office for the current one before a showing.
Lawn service at 14 Alder Court comes on Fridays; showings are fine while they work.

Ruth Hollis (seller): should we drop the price again before the weekend? Two more weekends without an offer worries us.
Handing 14 Alder Court to Jordan Pike while I am out from 2026-10-15; call the Hollis family Thursday afternoon, Saturday showing at 11:00.
